exposure: Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP) treatment (curettage, conservative management, medical therapy, resection, hysterectomy)
cohort: The study included 261 patients diagnosed with Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP) at Imam Khomeini Hospital in Ahvaz.
finding: The study highlighted significant rates of subsequent pregnancies and associated complications (infertility, recurrent CSP, placenta accreta, abnormal uterine bleeding, abortions) following Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP) treatment.
